name: Kasori Yuuko
source: Vice-President of the Student Council, who has an efficient and precise brain like a computer. She does most of the student council work alone and has a cool atmosphere. Yuuko is called "Razor Yuuko" because of her relentless and strict response and is feared by the other students.
